warnings: The sheet gives two alternative details for the same mark T1 — steel (top) and hardwood (bottom); recorded as two entries told apart by section_ref and material.

The steel chord profile is printed with a '⊥' symbol before 50x50x3.2 (and 40x40x3.2 for the king post), while the web members are printed 'L 40x40x3.2'. '⊥' is kept verbatim as the designation rather than translated (section 6a); it most likely means a back-to-back angle pair.
The bottom chord's size is not called out on this sheet; it comes from S-11 (ขื่อเหล็ก ⊥ 50x50x3.2มม).
Overhang/span chain 1.90 | 6.00 | 1.90 is recorded in the grid master; the truss supports are rows A and B.
